task: accurate_softmax scored on Boltz-2, both paths
host: tt-quietbox (qb1) card 1, p150a, fresh boot, benchlock held for all perf
note: A/A control reported first everywhere. Every fold is bit-deterministic at fixed seed, so every A/B delta is fully attributed (A/A = 0.000000 on every metric).

single_fold_wall_s_unwarmed.caveat: single unwarmed folds including compile; not a perf measurement, but the +14% direction says the 20 aa cell understates an O(N^2) cost

confidence_metrics_delta_vs_aa_mean.caveat: these are Boltz-2's own self-reported confidence outputs, not accuracy against a reference

structure_path.why: Costs 2.18% on the 20 aa cell against a 0.90% A/A spread, and moves the predicted structure 3.32 A at 20 aa / 1.63 A at 256 aa. The port already agrees with the GPU reference to 0.66 A, inside the reference's own 0.60 A seed floor (within_noise_floor true), so there is no 3.3 A of error available to fix and a 5x-the-band move cannot improve agreement. The confidence metrics rising is the model being more confident about a different structure, which is why self-reported confidence is not an accuracy metric.

affinity_path.switch: TT_BIO_B2_AFFINITY_ACCURATE_SOFTMAX (Fp32PairformerModule, 97.5% of the fold's softmax volume)

perf_cell_boltz2_affinity_per_s.caveat: median of 3 end-to-end subprocess runs each including model load and first-kernel compile; that is why the A/A spread is 5.79% and a 2% effect is not resolvable on this cell

ca_rmsd_angstrom.note: structure bit-identical: the fp32 trunk feeds the affinity head only, so the switch is correctly scoped

affinity_path.why: The op-level gain is real and large (29.07x at 4644, 27.95x at 4787 on rel_rms(o)), but it lands as 0.0367 log10(IC50) at the model level, below the GPU reference's own seed-to-seed floor of 0.0420 and inside the 0.0289-0.0590 band the gate already calls within_noise_floor. So it moves the number, not the bar. The perf cost is likewise below its cell's 5.79% A/A spread. Neither half of the trade is resolvable on this anchor, and an unmeasurable flip is exactly what the OpenDDE 60x precedent forbids.

op_level_accuracy_from_pass2.metric: rel_rms(probs @ v) on real captured pairs, real rows only, fp64 reference

nan_guard: validated end-to-end: the ON arm of the affinity fold completes and produces finite output. Without mask_floor, _accurate_softmax returns nan on 7.67 M of 28.3 M elements at 4644.
